text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, when making our way back to the academy, Kitasan Black says she wants to stop by a shrine, so we head over to one.
choice_data_list: So why did you want to visit a shrine all of a sudden?
So why did you want to visit a shrine all of a sudden?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Well, I haven't been feeling in top form lately, you see, so I asked my neighbors for advice, and…

text_block_list.name: Neighbor A
text_block_list.text: Hmm, you've been feeling off lately, have you? Well, that's no good.

text_block_list.name: Neighbor B
text_block_list.text: Have you tried doing a cleansing prayer? I sometimes go and do one when I'm feeling worse for wear. You should give it a try!

text_block_list.name: Neighbor A
text_block_list.text: They say that illness is born of the heart. You might be surprised at how effective a prayer can be. Ahaha!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: You're right! That just might work!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Anyway, that's the long and short of it. Hang on, I'll be right back!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: …Okay, all done!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Sorry to keep you waiting, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I hope my prayers will be heard and granted!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: At that very moment…

text_block_list.name: Neighbor A
text_block_list.text: Hey, Kita! What a coincidence running into you here! Are you here to pray?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Yes, I am! I just finished, actually!

text_block_list.name: Neighbor B
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! You beat us to it! We came to pray for you to get back to your usual energetic self!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: What?! You came all the way out here, just for me?!

text_block_list.name: Neighbor A
text_block_list.text: Of course! We hate to see you feeling down! Now then, if you'll excuse us, we have a prayer or two to make.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With that, the two of them head over to the shrine and clasp their hands together in prayer.

text_block_list.name: Neighbors A and B
text_block_list.text: May Kita's health quickly return to normal!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Th-thank you both!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Huh? What's this?!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I'm so happy! It's like I'm bursting with energy too! Wow, I feel great!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The kindness of her neighbors helps Kitasan Black perk back up and feel much better again.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Ah!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I just realized I'm always praying for stuff, but I never do anything in return! Shrines are such a big part of festivals too… I should be doing more!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I have to go convey my thanks properly and make sure I make my appreciation clear! Sorry, please hold on just a little more!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much for everything you do. I'm so grateful for how festivals put a smile on people's faces…

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: So thanks for that and, um, I'd like to thank you for the mikoshi parade from last summer, and also—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Kitasan Black's fervent prayers and expression of thanks take longer than expected…

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Sorry for the wait! I managed to say all my thanks!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Phew… Wow, am I exhausted, though…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It seems her heartfelt prayer actually ended up fatiguing her even more. Kitasan Black's condition doesn't improve at all.
